12d7d589a995c908.title: RamanOmics decodes the spatial vibrational–molecular architecture of senescence in aging and repair
digest: Zhang, Chen, Monticolo, Sorrentino and colleagues pair label-free Raman imaging with spatial and single-cell transcriptomics to probe biochemical signatures of senescence in aging and repair, identifying a lipid-linked Raman signature of p21+ cells.

a1202cc5c6851c30.title: The chemical fingerprint of cellular senescence
digest: Senescence has traditionally been studied largely on the basis of changes in gene expression, but senescent cells also undergo profound biochemical remodeling.

Zhang and colleagues introduce RamanOmics, a multimodal approach that links Raman-based chemical imaging with spatial transcriptomics to reveal the hidden biochemical landscape of cellular senescence.

d6b27994e0c587a4.title: SPLENDID incorporates continuous genetic ancestry in biobank-scale data to improve polygenic risk prediction across diverse populations
digest: Rather than relying on pre-specified ancestry labels, which often fail to capture the full genetic heterogeneity of diverse populations, SPLENDID treats ancestry as a continuum and improves polygenic risk score (PRS) prediction for biobank-scale datasets.

28621939099579f3.title: NanoTS: a deep learning tool for accurate SNP calling in nanopore long-read transcriptome data
digest: NanoTS facilitates nanopore long-read transcriptome sequencing based SNP detection and genotype calling using deep learning.

c3777b3a045cd354.title: A versatile nanopore identifies four classes of analytes simultaneously
digest: A versatile nanopore sensor, created by modifying a bacterial porin, enables the simultaneous identification of amino acids, nucleoside monophosphates, saccharides and peptides.
7% classification accuracy and enables the compositional analysis of native glycopeptides.

26d48cde47bb2bb0.title: Program Launch Manager
digest:
About Convergent Research
Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO).
We design, launch, and support mission-driven, time-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.

e5f7b79a7bb3104d.title: Senior/Research Associate, Single Cell Technology
digest: Company info NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan.
We’re developing medicines to treat age-related diseases by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore regenerative potential in aged and diseased cells.

370040ce8a38b75f.title: Cytotoxic CD4+ T cells support age-associated myelopoiesis
digest: Aging is associated with myeloid-biased hematopoiesis, which leads to the establishment of a pro-inflammatory microenvironment.
We discovered that cytotoxic CD4+ T cells foster this process via the CCL5–CCR5 axis and found that the clinically approved CCR5 antagonist maraviroc can rebalance immunity in aged mice.

52222922d686c19b.title: Media and Outreach Specialist
digest: Dragonfly is a Convergent Research Focused Research Organization (FRO).
Our mission is to capture the faint cosmic web of gas that connects galaxies across the universe, using a groundbreaking distributed-aperture telescope with over 1000 high-end telephoto lenses.

efb80ccd9f8fce7b.title: An engineered nanopore identifies saccharides, amino acids, peptides and ribonucleotides
digest: Modified nanopore simultaneously identifies diverse biomolecules and their modifications.

bdda45053a2b33db.title: Large-scale mapping of microproteins in the aged human brain
digest: Microproteins, small proteins of 100–150 amino acids, are largely absent from reference proteomes and have been overlooked in brain and aging research.

An atlas of the aged human brain catalogs over 1,000 high-confidence microproteins, including one encoded by the MKKS gene that is reduced in Alzheimer’s disease and regulates energy production in microglia.

97517bcad5d53661.title: Partner, AI Resilience
digest: Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): purpose-built, mission-driven orgs designed to solve technological bottlenecks, unlock whole new fields, and lead to scaled revolutions.
We’ve proven our model works by building over 14 high-impact scientific organizations spanning AI, biotech, mathematics, climate science, and more.
